headline: Profit margins expand sharply on modest revenue growth

kpis.label: Net profit attributable to parent (H1 YTD)

summary_short: H1 FY2026 revenue was ¥4.41bn, up 1.85% y/y, while operating profit surged 438.13% y/y to ¥348.1M; the shard's discrete Q2 EPS of ¥0.10 rose 25.0% q/q from ¥0.08.
summary_long: H1 FY2026 revenue reached ¥4.41bn, up 1.85% y/y from ¥4.33bn. Operating profit rose 438.13% y/y to ¥348.1M; net profit attributable to parent was ¥230.7M (no prior-period figure surfaced). The shard's discrete Q2 EPS of ¥0.10 rose 25.0% q/q from ¥0.08 — consistent with the H1 total (Q1 + Q2 ≈ ¥0.18, matching the filing's reported H1 basic EPS of ¥0.18). No margin, guidance, or cash-position figures were read from a parseable primary; drivers and guidance not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. 002511 C1 (C&S Paper Co.,Ltd / 中顺洁柔, 002511.SZ) has no edgarCik and the shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback (kind="fallback"), so Step 1 attempted WebSearch (Rung 4) before downgrading. First WebSearch (English) surfaced only aggregators (PitchBook, stockanalysis.com, Yahoo, Futunn, MarketScreener, ResearchInChina, SimplyWall.st) — no company IR page or wire-service release. A second WebSearch (Chinese company name 中顺洁柔) surfaced a Sina Finance interim-report bulletin listing page, which linked to the 2026-08-21 半年度报告 (half-year report) announcement detail page (a mirror of the SZSE/cninfo disclosure) — one day after the shard's eventDate of 2026-08-20; likely a disclosure-timestamp vs trading-day artifact, not corrected on reported_at. Fetching that page yielded structured H1 2026 figures: revenue ¥4,409.68M (+1.85% y/y), operating profit ¥348.09M (+438.13% y/y), net profit attributable to parent ¥230.71M (no prior figure surfaced), and H1 basic EPS ¥0.18 — internally consistent with the shard's discrete Q1+Q2 EPS sum (¥0.08+¥0.10=¥0.18). A third fetch attempt on the underlying filing PDF (file.finance.sina.com.cn mirror) returned unparseable binary/garbled content — no MD&A driver text or guidance language was recoverable, so drivers[] and guidance[] were not populated. Budget used: 2/2 WebSearch, 3/3 fetches.
